name: zygonic - Integrated Productivity
tagline: Type a task and it sets up the starting point in your apps, like a drafted email, without doing it for you.

awards: Smart Task Accelerator presented by Grainger

problem: Starting a task is the hardest part; interrupted tasks linger in memory.
solution: A macOS menu-bar app sends tasks to n8n workflows that prepare the first step in Gmail and other apps.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter a task and find a draft waiting in Gmail.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Smart Task Accelerator presented by Grainger” among 122 submissions.
Prepares, but leaves the work to the user.

lessons: Lower the activation energy instead of doing the task.
